options.name: label
options.description: Accessible name of the tree.

options.name: nodes
options.description: The nodes ({ id, label, icon?, expandedIcon?, children?, hasChildren?, disabled? }); ids must be unique.

options.name: selection
options.description: Selection mode.

options.name: selected
options.description: Ids of the selected nodes.

options.name: checkboxes
options.description: Show a checkbox per node; Space toggles it.

options.name: checked
options.description: Ids of the checked nodes.

options.name: cascade
options.description: Checking a parent checks its descendants; parents show the mixed state.

options.name: expanded
options.description: Ids of the expanded nodes.

options.name: loadChildren
options.type: ((node: TreeNode, context: TreeViewLoadContext) => Promise<readonly TreeNode[]>) | null
options.description: Loads the children of a node with hasChildren on first expansion; receives an AbortSignal.

options.name: draggable
options.description: Nodes can be moved by dragging and with Ctrl+X / Ctrl+V and Alt+Up / Alt+Down.

options.name: canDrag
options.description: Which nodes may be moved.

options.name: canDrop
options.type: (source: TreeNode, target: TreeNode | null, position: TreeViewDropPosition) => boolean
options.description: Whether a node may be dropped before, inside, or after a target.

options.name: renamable
options.description: Nodes can be renamed with F2 or a double click on the label.

options.name: filter
options.description: Show matching nodes and the paths to them (case and accent insensitive); matches are highlighted.

options.name: filterBy
options.description: Custom filter match instead of the label match.

options.name: itemHeight
options.description: Row height in pixels (24 to 200). Default by density: 32, 40, or 48.

options.name: height
options.description: Block size of the scroll area as a CSS length, or null to fill the host.

options.name: empty
options.description: Text shown when there are no nodes.

options.name: direction
options.description: Writing direction for the arrow keys. Default: the computed direction of the host.

options.name: icons
options.description: Twisty, loading, and error icons.

options.name: overscan
options.description: Rows rendered beyond each edge of the visible area (0 to 100).

options.name: locale
options.description: Locale of messages, filtering, and type-ahead.

options.name: density
options.description: Default row height when itemHeight is not set.

properties.name: nodes
properties.description: The current tree, including loaded children, moves, and renames.

properties.name: indeterminate
properties.description: Ids of parents in the mixed state.

properties.name: matches
properties.description: Ids of the nodes matching filter, in visible order.

properties.name: range
properties.description: The visible rows { start, end } (end exclusive).

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expand a node and its ancestors, loading lazy children.

methods.name: focusNode
methods.description: Focus a node, expanding its ancestors and scrolling it into view.

methods.name: scrollToNode
methods.description: Scroll a node into view, expanding its ancestors.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Load a lazy node's children again.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: A node of the current tree.

methods.name: getParentId
methods.description: The id of a node's parent.

methods.name: getItemElement
methods.description: The rendered treeitem of a node, or null.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, observers, and listeners; abort loads.

events.name: aui-select
events.description: The user changed the selection: { selected, id }.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: The user toggled a checkbox: { checked, indeterminate, id }.

events.name: aui-expand
events.description: The user expanded or collapsed a node: { id, open, expanded }.

events.name: aui-move
events.description: A node is about to move (drag or keyboard): { id, parentId, index, previousParentId, previousIndex, source }; preventDefault() keeps it in place.

events.name: aui-rename
events.description: A node is about to be renamed: { id, label, previousLabel }; preventDefault() keeps the old label.

events.name: aui-activate
events.description: A node was activated with Enter or a double click: { id, node }.

cssClasses.name: aui-tree-view--fill | --empty | --checkboxes | --draggable | --dragging
cssClasses.description: Fill the host, no nodes, checkbox mode, movable nodes, a drag in progress.

cssClasses.name: aui-tree-view__twisty | __check | __icon | __label | __match | __error | __input
cssClasses.description: Twisty, checkbox, icon, label, filter match, load error text, and rename input.
